verdict.rationale: Make stores connections as team-scoped entities: the API lists all connections for a team, so credentials are held centrally and shared at team level. Each connection also has a documented entity access list (ACL) of principals granted a role on it, which provides per-credential control over who can use it. missing for 10: details on available roles and permission semantics, UI-level documentation of sharing and restricting connections, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can store connection credentials centrally, share them with my team, and control who can use which credential

citations.quote: Retrieves a collection of all connections for a team with a given ID.
The following endpoints let you view and manage the access list (entity ACL) of a connection — the principals granted a role on it.
